Title: Ealing Beaver Project guided walk, Paradise Fields (Thu 5 Nov)
Address: Paradise Fields, meeting point at the underpass entrance inside Westway Cross Retail Park (next to McDonald’s), 1000 Greenford Road
PriceText: Adults £10 (plus booking fee); under-18s free with a paying adult
Description: Guided 90-minute walk round the Ealing Beaver Project site at Paradise Fields: dams, feeding signs and other wildlife (you are unlikely to see the beavers themselves). Families welcome; keep to the paths and keep noise down
NeedsInfo: Not a children’s event as such, but families welcome. More walks are added to the Eventbrite collection over time. Read 30 Oct 2026
